verdict.rationale: Kong offers official CLIs (decK for declarative config/APIOps and Inso CLI for Insomnia automation), confirmed hands-on with decK installing and running via brew (kong-probe-4), plus documented CLI usage for tests/linting in CI (kong-docs-13, kong-docs-14, kong-docs-39). These are general API/gateway management CLIs rather than AI-agent-specific CLIs, so 'AI-native' framing is only partially addressed via AI Gateway/MCP docs, not a dedicated agentic CLI.
